biological_question: How quickly will the protective microsphere shell dissolve under different pH conditions
method_summary: First-order dissolution with a pH-dependent rate constant
limitations: The fitted demonstration table is simulated and the later experiment provides only bounded qualitative agreement

biological_question: What speed can a calcium-carbonate micromotor sustain in acidic gastric fluid
method_summary: Low-Reynolds-number drag and reaction-driven motion solved as an equation of motion
limitations: The calculation assumes ideal spherical motion and does not establish safety or in-vivo propulsion

biological_question: How do microspheres move adhere and leave an idealized gastric cavity
method_summary: Brownian particle motion with fluid flow boundary adhesion and outlet states
limitations: The reported adhesion fraction depends on idealized geometry probabilities and flow assumptions without biological validation

biological_question: Under what velocity radius and angle can a microsphere cross gastric mucus
method_summary: Energy-balance criterion for motion through a uniform Newtonian mucus layer
limitations: Uniform-fluid and rigid-sphere assumptions limit translation to heterogeneous living mucus

biological_question: Is the proposed adhesion complex structurally stable under simulated physiological conditions
method_summary: All-atom molecular dynamics with equilibrium stability flexibility and interaction analyses
limitations: Simulation stability does not demonstrate cellular adhesion or binding strength in the intended biological context

biological_question: Which engineered GPCR designs are promising and how might their downstream signal evolve
method_summary: Docking and membrane molecular dynamics feed an ODE description of the G-protein and MAPK pathway
limitations: Several trajectories do not fully converge and many kinetic parameters are literature-derived or assumed rather than fitted to the engineered system

biological_question: How does secreted AiiA concentration change over space and time around engineered yeast
method_summary: Reaction-diffusion equation with degradation and numerical discretization
limitations: Predicted therapeutic ranges depend on simplified geometry and literature parameters without direct spatial measurements

biological_question: How could an intervention alter population-level H. pylori infection trajectories
method_summary: Compartmental epidemic model extending SIR with intervention terms
limitations: Population forecasts are scenario demonstrations and do not validate clinical efficacy

biological_question: Which candidate binders can expand the ligand space of the synthetic receptor
method_summary: BindCraft and AlphaFold-based generation with confidence filtering before wet-lab testing
limitations: The generation workflow is restricted to selected epitopes and candidate success remains assay-dependent

biological_question: Which computational metric best prioritizes generated binders for experiments
method_summary: Umbrella-sampling free-energy profiles and an ML comparator are ranked against a cell-free binding assay
limitations: The ranking uses five tested binders and the quantitative affinity interpretation of umbrella sampling remains method-sensitive

biological_question: Which transmembrane-domain pair minimizes background dimerization
method_summary: Coarse-grained Martini membrane simulations compare receptor-pair dimerization behavior
limitations: The tested domain set is small and future kinetic-rate extraction is not yet established

biological_question: How do ligand and receptor concentrations determine dimerized receptor abundance
method_summary: Steady-state ligand binding and receptor dimerization solved from a constrained polynomial system
limitations: The quasi-equilibrium model omits temporal behavior and background dimerization

biological_question: How do kinase and phosphatase ratios control active substrate abundance
method_summary: Steady-state phosphorylation and dephosphorylation kinetics generate circuit dose-response curves
limitations: Unknown absolute intracellular concentrations require ratio scaling and limit parameter interpretation

biological_question: Which receptor composition gives useful activation and inhibition under two ligands
method_summary: The sensing and processing layers are coupled into an end-to-end steady-state input-output model
limitations: Agreement is demonstrated for selected receptor ratios and does not establish universal predictive accuracy

biological_question: How sharply and at what threshold does a circuit architecture switch
method_summary: Adaptive sampling and Hill-curve analysis estimate switching slope and half-maximal response
limitations: The initial validation covers the intracellular processing module and shows a gradual rather than ultrasensitive switch

biological_question: Which available circuit architecture is closest to a requested switching profile
method_summary: A precomputed parameter-combination database uses standardized Euclidean distance for top-k design retrieval
limitations: Returned candidates still require experimental validation and database coverage is limited to available characterized components

biological_question: How quickly can different tyrosinase and nanocage combinations produce dopaquinone
method_summary: Coupled Michaelis-Menten differential equations compare enzyme and cage configurations
limitations: Pore flux reversibility and enzyme behavior after attachment are assumed and need direct measurement

biological_question: How many melanin-producing cells or beads are needed to reach a target transmission
method_summary: A modified Beer-Lambert calculation consumes the 48-hour kinetics output and idealized cell stacking
limitations: Hydrogel scattering skin absorption cell orientation and actual melanin yield are not measured in the model

biological_question: Where can tyrosinase be split while retaining reconstitution potential
method_summary: SPELL screening is followed by AlphaFold Boltz and Rosetta structure and energy checks
limitations: Several candidates fail at expression or solubility stages and predicted geometry alone cannot prove enzymatic reconstitution

biological_question: Can a redesigned lid suppress activity until protease activation
method_summary: Structure prediction affinity estimation and energy refinement guide linker and cleavage-site design
limitations: Validation is specific to the tested HcTyr1 construct and does not generalize to all lid-domain enzymes

biological_question: What fusion loading and linker geometry can fit inside an assembled nanocage
method_summary: Reduced assembly units and multi-tool structure analysis compare loading ratios and steric compatibility
limitations: Native PAGE cannot distinguish correct cages from aggregates and activity of the large assemblies was not established

biological_question: How do temperature pH and expandable environmental factors change engineered bacterial growth
method_summary: CCD response-surface fitting is extended with a modular gamma-interaction formulation
limitations: The experimental design contains few unique conditions and extension to humidity or osmotic pressure remains proposed

biological_question: How does engineered bacterial survival change after nutrient depletion at different initial densities
method_summary: First- and second-order phases are fitted and related to a density-dependent ODE interpretation
limitations: The mechanism-level ODE interpretation extends beyond the directly fitted phasewise survival curves

biological_question: How can endpoint plate assays parameterize nonlinear attacker-to-prey killing behavior
method_summary: Each starting ratio receives a separate effective killing parameter for lookup by the simulator
limitations: Five-hour endpoint values do not identify continuous-time kinetics and should not be pooled across untested environments

biological_question: How might copy number blue light signaling and toxin neutralization determine engineered-cell survival
method_summary: A staged regulatory ODE and statistical survival model links promoter signaling immunity and toxin activity
limitations: Several numerical values are midpoint assumptions or extrapolations and the complete pathway is not calibrated as an integrated system

biological_question: How do local particle encounters translate calibrated killing strength into spatial population dynamics
method_summary: A C and OpenGL particle system simulates bacterial encounters using condition-specific killing parameters
limitations: The particle interaction rules are calibrated to endpoint assays and do not independently validate spatial or time-resolved killing

biological_question: How do promoter repeat count and illumination affect optogenetic expression
method_summary: Experimental characterization informs predictive induction equations and sensitivity analysis
limitations: A small condition set supports the selected circuit iteration rather than general optogenetic performance

biological_question: When will the culture reach 99 percent flocculation for collection
method_summary: Experimental flocculation dynamics are converted into a predictive timing relation for reactor automation
limitations: The stopping rule is bounded to tested culture and induction conditions and should not be generalized across strains or reactor scales

biological_question: Which molecular designs remain promising across sequence structure and mesoscale analyses
method_summary: A linked three-scale computational pipeline ranks candidates and exposes its HPC requirements
limitations: Large unprocessed data volume and computational scale are limitations rather than evidence of validation

biological_question: How might an engineered intervention propagate across four physiological stages
method_summary: Coupled equations connect four physiological stages and expose each module's parameter and evidence status
limitations: Many parameters are assumed and one manually drafted dataset demonstrates the method rather than a biological prediction

biological_question: How do environmental spread and vascular transport propagate into expression and antigen binding
method_summary: Linked models connect environmental spread transport expression and molecular binding across four scales
limitations: Assumptions parameter provenance and calibration boundaries are distributed across a dense page and only selected transport trends are compared with qPCR

biological_question: Which knockout candidates improve the target phenotype while remaining compatible with observed growth
method_summary: A genome-scale digital twin is checked against measured growth before computational knockout screening
limitations: The reported accuracy uses a small test set and industrial scale-up conclusions remain simulation-based

biological_question: Which kinetic parameters dominate model output and which wet-lab measurements should be repeated
method_summary: A parameterized kinetic model combines global sensitivity analysis with targeted wet-lab repeats
limitations: Fitted parameters and independently validated parameters must remain distinguishable when interpreting agreement

biological_question: How do the modeled components interact quantitatively and which design choices follow
method_summary: A system diagram is translated into ODEs with a parameter table separating assumed and literature-derived values
limitations: The approximation depends heavily on estimated parameters and needs dimensional checks uncertainty propagation and stronger independent validation
